5/5: Janaye Ingram (@Airbnb ): As your world becomes bigger and at the same time smaller..make sure the young people are part of it..children need to be exposed to what travel can offer..travel is life, travel is life affirming. #BlackHistoryMonth @NAACP @MoADsf @nomadnesstribe

4/5: Evita Robinson (Nomadness Travel Tribe): Everything comes back to community... having a community everywhere shrinks the world enough to have the confidence to go anywhere... #BlackHistoryMonth @nomadnesstribe @NAACP @Airbnb @MoADsf

3/5: Derrick Johnson (NAACP): How do expose young people... expose the economic opportunity... how do we monetize the Black experience... how do we use travel as a tool to advance social justice... #BlackHistoryMonth @NAACP @MoADsf @nomadnesstribe @Airbnb

2/5: Laura Murphy (@Airbnb/former head of travel in DC): Travel is a major way of drawing connections... when we sit down and break bread...need to overcome generations of segregation and segregated thinking...” #BlackHistoryMonth @MoADsf @nomadnesstribe @NAACP

1/5: Really great to see SF Museum of the African Diaspora & @airbnb talking the future of Black travel. Panel featuring NAACP’s Derrick Johnson, Laura Murphy & Evita Robinson of Nomadness Travel. Moderated by Janaye Ingram. #BlackHistoryMonth @MoADsf @NAACP @nomadnesstribe
